company.shortDescription: Liabify is a fintech platform offering earned wage access, payroll integration, and employee financial wellness solutions.
company.description: Liabify is a fintech company providing earned wage access and employee financial wellness solutions for modern workplaces. Its platform integrates with payroll systems, enabling employees to access earned salaries before payday while helping employers improve retention and productivity. Liabify focuses on reducing financial stress through flexible salary access, digital financial tools, and seamless payroll integration designed for businesses and workforce management platforms.
